The Biryani Story

A Royal Legacy
on Every Plate

Biriyani traces its roots to the royal kitchens of Persia, travelled through India, and found its heart in Hyderabad, where Mughal and Deccani flavours came together to create a legendary dish.

Rahim's Biriyani Co. carries that legacy forward — prepared fresh, sealed with care, and delivered to your table with the same devotion that has defined Hyderabadi cooking for generations.

Origin
Persian Royal Kitchens
Spiced rice and slow-cooked meat — the foundations of an enduring culinary tradition.
Arrival
The Indian Subcontinent
Traders and courtiers carry the tradition across the subcontinent, absorbing local spices along the way.
Refinement
The Deccan Courts
Saffron, dum cooking and local ingredients transform biriyani into something entirely new.
Home
Hyderabad — The Final Destination
Mughal technique meets Deccani flavour. The legendary Hyderabadi Biriyani is born and perfected.
Our Family Story

From the Syed Family Kitchen

Every pot of our biriyani begins with one woman — Ameena Bee.

In her Hyderabad kitchen, Ameena Bee cooked biriyani the way it was always meant to be made: patiently, by hand, sealed and slow-cooked over a gentle dum fire. Whenever the family gathered, it was her biriyani everyone waited for.

Her daughter, Rehana Syed, grew up at her side — learning every measure of spice, every layer of rice and every minute of dum. She carried those techniques, and that same love, into her own kitchen, and served her biriyani to relatives far and wide. Wherever the family came together, Rehana's biriyani was at the centre of the table.

Rehana's son, Abdul Rahim Syed, grew up with the taste of his grandmother's recipe and his mother's cooking. Learning from them both, he set out to take it beyond the family — and bring it to everyone's table.

Rahim's Biriyani Co. is that promise: the same recipe, cooked the same way, sealed fresh, and shared with the same warmth.

1st Generation · Where It BeganAmeena BeeGrandmother · Hyderabad

Started it all — cooking the authentic biriyani that became the heart of every family gathering.

2nd Generation · Carried ForwardRehana SyedAmeena Bee's daughter

Carried her mother's techniques and love, and served the family biriyani to all their relatives.

3rd Generation · To Every TableAbdul Rahim SyedRehana's son · Founder, Rahim's Biriyani Co.

Brought the family biriyani beyond home — fresh, sealed and ready for everyone to share.

The Complete Meal

Everything in One Pack

A complete Hyderabadi feast, sealed fresh in our signature three-compartment pack — ready to serve.

1
Chicken Biriyani
675 g · Main Compartment

Slow-cooked Hyderabadi-style chicken biriyani with long-grain basmati, whole spices, saffron and caramelised onions. Prepared fresh — no preservatives, no shortcuts.

2
Onion Raitha
120 mL · Side 1

Chilled, creamy yoghurt folded with thinly sliced red onion and fresh coriander, finished with a dusting of roasted cumin. Cool and refreshing — the perfect balance to every spicy mouthful of biriyani.

3
Mirchi ka Salan
120 mL · Side 2

Hyderabad's classic partner to biriyani — long green chillies slow-cooked in a rich, nutty gravy of roasted peanuts, sesame and coconut, brightened with tangy tamarind. Gently spiced, deeply flavourful, and made to be spooned over every bite.
